# Security

Report suspected credential leaks or security vulnerabilities privately using
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/security/advisories/new).
Do not include IBKR tokens, Ghostfolio credentials, account identifiers or real
transaction exports in public issues or pull requests.

Security fixes target the current `main` branch. Older releases do not receive
separate backports. Dependency and image security checks run on pull requests
and weekly; merging a fix publishes an image but does not deploy the NAS.
